race.title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
race.verdict: Cases can be made for plenty of these so it could pay to take a chance on DAAMBERDIPLOMAT , who was last seen in winning action here in October last year and returns from just 1 lb higher having since joined the shrewd Ado McGuinness outfit. Caffu Zafeen arrives in search of a 5-timer, so he merits considerable respect, with All The Girls and Eddie G another couple worth considering, as well. DAAMBERDIPLOMAT (IRE) CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE) ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Firewalker (10/3), Caffu Zafeen (7/2), Sir Les Patterson (5/1), All The Girls (5/1), Eddie G (6/1), City House (7/1), Kerdos (10/1), Daamberdiplomat (14/1), Chicago Pope (16/1), Frescobaldi (25/1)
